cards.ex: He always looks so well-groomed, like he just stepped out of a magazine.
cards.exUz: U har doim juda ozoda ko'rinadi, xuddi jurnal sahifasidan tushgandek.
cards.uzDef: Odamning tashqi ko'rinishi toza va tartibli.

cards.ex: She has striking features that make her stand out in a crowd.
cards.exUz: Uning ajoyib xususiyatlari uni olomon orasida ajratib turadi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning yuzidagi diqqatga sazovor, ko'zni tortadigan xususiyatlar.

cards.ex: He's a bit on the heavy side, but he's working on losing weight.
cards.exUz: U biroz to'laroq, lekin vazn tashlashga harakat qilyapti.
cards.term: a bit on the heavy side
cards.uzDef: Odamning vazni normadan biroz ko'proq.

cards.ex: She was dressed to kill at the party last night.
cards.exUz: U kecha kechqurun ziyofatda hayratda qoldirish uchun kiyingan edi.
cards.uzDef: Odam juda chiroyli va jozibali kiyingan.

cards.ex: My grandma looks so young for her age; you'd never guess she's 70.
cards.exUz: Mening buvim o'z yoshidan juda yosh ko'rinadi; uning 70 da ekanligiga hech kim ishonmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Odam o'z yoshidan ancha yoshroq ko'rinadi.

cards.ex: He decided to sport a beard for the winter months.
cards.exUz: U qish oylari uchun soqol qo'yishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Soqol o'stirib yurmoq.

cards.ex: She comes across as very confident, even if she's nervous inside.
cards.exUz: U juda ishonchli ko'rinadi, hatto ichida asabiylashgan bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: O'zini qandaydir qilib ko'rsatmoq, taassurot qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: She was so stunning that she made me do a double take.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik go'zal ediki, meni qayta qarashga majbur qildi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirga hayron bo'lib qayta qarash.

cards.ex: Despite being a celebrity, she's very down-to-earth and easy to talk to.
cards.exUz: Mashhur bo'lishiga qaramay, u juda oddiy va suhbatlashish oson.
cards.uzDef: Odamning xushmuomala, oddiy va tabiiy xulq-atvorga ega.

cards.ex: She carries herself with such grace and confidence.
cards.exUz: U o'zini shunday nafislik va ishonch bilan tutadi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning o'zini qanday tutishi, yurishi, gavdasini ushlashi.

cards.ex: He's in good shape for his age; he works out every day.
cards.exUz: U o'z yoshi uchun yaxshi holatda; u har kuni mashq qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning sog'lom va sport bilan shug'ullanadigan holatda.

cards.ex: She always looks so put-together, even on casual days.
cards.exUz: U har doim juda chiroyli ko'rinadi, hatto oddiy kunlarda ham.
cards.uzDef: Odamning tashqi ko'rinishi tartibli, zamonaviy va yaxshi uyg'unlashgan.

cards.ex: Her bright red hair made her stand out in the crowd.
cards.exUz: Uning yorqin qizil sochlari uni olomon ichida ajratib turardi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ko'zga tashlanadigan darajada farq qilmoq.

cards.ex: She's on the slender side, but she's very strong.
cards.exUz: U ozg'inroq, lekin juda kuchli.
cards.uzDef: Odamning tana tuzilishi ozg'inroq.

cards.ex: She's a real head-turner; everyone stares when she walks by.
cards.exUz: U juda go'zal; u o'tib ketayotganda hamma unga qaraydi.
cards.uzDef: Odam juda chiroyli, odamlarning e'tiborini tortadigan.

cards.ex: She has a radiant smile that can brighten anyone's day.
cards.exUz: Uning nurli tabassumi har kimning kunini yoritishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Odamning yuzini yoritadigan, juda chiroyli tabassum.

cards.ex: He's in his prime as an athlete; he's breaking records every year.
cards.exUz: U sportchi sifatida eng zo'r paytida; u har yili rekordlarni yangilaydi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning hayotining eng yaxshi davri, ayniqsa jismoniy jihatdan.

cards.ex: She's a natural beauty; she doesn't need to wear much makeup.
cards.exUz: U tabiiy go'zal; unga ko'p makiyaj qilishning hojati yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Odam tabiiy go'zallikka ega, makiyajsiz ham chiroyli.

cards.ex: She's aged gracefully; she looks fantastic for her age.
cards.exUz: U go'zal qaridi; u o'z yoshi uchun ajoyib ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Odam qarigan sari chiroyli va xushbichimligini saqlab qolgan.

cards.ex: She still has a youthful glow about her, even in her 50s.
cards.exUz: U 50 yoshda bo'lsa ham, uning yuzida hali ham yoshlik nuri bor.
cards.uzDef: Odamning yuzidagi sog'lom va yoshga xos nur.

cards.ex: If you want to be taken seriously, you need to dress the part.
cards.exUz: Agar sizni jiddiy qabul qilishlarini istasangiz, o'z roliingizga mos kiyinishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z roli yoki lavozimiga mos keladigan tarzda kiyinmoq.

cards.ex: He has a commanding presence that makes everyone listen when he speaks.
cards.exUz: Uning ta'sirli ko'rinishi bor, u gapirganda hamma uni tinglaydi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning tashqi ko'rinishi va xulq-atvori orqali boshqalarga ta'sir o'tkazadigan kuchli taassurot.

cards.ex: He looks tough, but looks can be deceiving; he's actually very kind.
cards.exUz: U qattiqqo'l ko'rinadi, lekin tashqi ko'rinish aldamchi bo'lishi mumkin; u aslida juda mehribon.
cards.uzDef: Odamning tashqi ko'rinishi uning haqiqiy xususiyatlarini aks ettirmasligi mumkin.

cards.ex: He's a sharp dresser; he always looks like he's stepped out of a magazine.
cards.exUz: U moda kiyinuvchi; u har doim jurnal sahifasidan tushgandek ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Doimo zamonaviy va chiroyli kiyinadigan odam.

cards.ex: She's plain-looking, but she has a wonderful personality.
cards.exUz: U oddiy ko'rinishga ega, lekin uning ajoyib shaxsiyati bor.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli yoki jozibali bo'lmagan odam.

cards.ex: She's rumored to have gone under the knife to improve her appearance.
cards.exUz: U tashqi ko'rinishini yaxshilash uchun operatsiya qildirgan deb mish-mishlar tarqalgan.
cards.uzDef: Kosmetik operatsiya qildirmoq.

cards.ex: He has a winning smile that can charm anyone.
cards.exUz: Uning jonli tabassumi bor, u har kimni o'ziga jalb qila oladi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning boshqalarni o'ziga jalb qiladigan tabassumi.

cards.ex: He has a twinkle in his eye that suggests he's always up to something.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'zida bir chaqnash bor, bu uning doimo nimadir o'ylab yurishini ko'rsatadi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning ko'zlarida kulgi yoki hiyla borligini bildiradigan chaqnash.

cards.ex: They were dressed to the nines for the gala.
cards.exUz: Ular gala uchun eng zo'r kiyimlarini kiyishgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Odam eng yaxshi, eng zamonaviy kiyimlarini kiygan.

cards.ex: "Age before beauty," he said, gesturing for her to go first.
cards.exUz: «Katta hurmati», dedi u, unga birinchi o'tishga ishora qilib.
cards.uzDef: Kattalarga hurmat ko'rsatish lozim.
